scope: Source syntax inventory of ribbon modules and context-menu modules; entries are evidence locations, not accepted commands.
limitations: Dynamic variants need expansion against their providers.
Dialogs, supporting panes, keyboard routes and imported helpers need separate review.
No plugin adapter or persistence is inferred from a matching command string.
